items.title: Vanishing of the first direct image of the dualizing module in the rational singularity situation

items.difficulty_reason: The proposition proves that in the rational singularity situation, with the source normal and the base Nagata and admitting a dualizing complex, the first direct image of the dualizing module of the source vanishes (statement lines 1837-1846). The proof (proof lines 1848-1887) normalizes the dualizing complex, reduces a failure of vanishing to a nonzero map to the residue field, applies the dualizing functor with two displayed identifications to convert it into a map from the residue field into the pushforward of the structure sheaf, and excludes the latter by the injectivity of the restriction of the first cohomology. H3: a duality argument with two computations, written out in full.
